messages:
Nadia: Heads up 4 Auralytics (acct AL-210) opened a dispute on INV-5177 (May). They say bulk similarity jobs were billed at on-demand embedding rate instead of batch rate; they estimate $14,200 in overcharge and want a 90-day installment.
Keon: Can we confirm whether requests hit the batch endpoint or were routed to the per-call embedding SKU? Need request paths + model ids.
Nadia: Links: https://billing.redwood.example/invoices/INV-5177  https://logs.redwood.example/al-210/usage/2026-05
Alberto: Quick glance at logs: many calls went to /v1/embeddings with header X-Batch:false between 04:00-06:20 UTC on 2026-05-18. Could be connector misconfiguration.
Priya: CS says they discovered a staging job that pointed at prod and retried in small batches, so each retry billed as on-demand. Finance willing to pay 30% today if we credit the overcharged portion.
Marcus: Collections prefer: initial 30% payment, formal payment schedule, and a signed acknowledgement withdrawing dispute for credited portion. We can consider a one-time correction for misbilling.
Keon: Ops ask: can we detect 'retry storms' vs intentional small-batch workloads and suggest cheaper batch SKU? Could be a product-side metering gap.
Nadia: My suggestion: offer a resolution that combines a technical fix + financial remedy: 1) one-time credit equal to verified overcharge up to $8k, 2) accept 30% today, remainder over 90 days (3 installments), 3) require signed ack and temporary soft throttle while on plan.
Alberto: I'll reconcile exact overcharge number by EOD. If it's connector misconfig, we should also propose a free trial of batch-SKU routing for 30 days and have devex follow up.
Priya: Customer verbally agreed to pay an initial amount if we confirm credit and send plan doc. They asked explicitly to avoid service interruption.
billing-bot: Billing system: Automatic invoice note added "Dispute opened: customer claims misrouting to on-demand SKU" at 2012345690.
collections-bot: Dunning bot: 1st_notice sent to AL-210 for INV-5177 at 2012345695. Next escalation: account hold in 12 days if unpaid.
Marcus: Legal: include language that refund/credit applies only if logs confirm misbilling and that by signing they withdraw dispute for amount covered by the credit and payment plan. I can draft a short addendum.
Keon: Also filing an internal ticket for a metering rule: detect repeated small retries within a 2-hour window and suggest batch routing. Flagging as DE-4121.
Nadia: Plan: Alberto to post reconciled overcharge numbers, Marcus to draft addendum, Priya to schedule call and request initial payment. If we receive payment + signed doc, Collections will mark invoice On Payment Plan and postpone hold.
Alberto: Reconciliation complete: verified overcharge $7,850 due to retry pattern. Posting CSV to secure share. Recommend offering $7,850 credit and proceed with 30% upfront then 3 equal installments over 90 days.
Priya: On call now: finance committed to 30% payment and to sign the addendum. Sending invoice link and DocuSign.
collections-bot: Payment received: partial payment $4,650 for INV-5177 at 2012345745. Invoice status set to On Payment Plan.
Nadia: Thanks team. Devex please follow up on DE-4121 to avoid repeat incidents. Reopen thread if payment missed or dispute reappears.
